meta.title: fix(timeline): remove notch listeners on redraw
meta.body_summary: Fix memory leak in Timeline plugin by removing notch scroll listeners on redraw, preventing listener accumulation that causes memory growth.

perf_labels.notes: 8-line change in timeline plugin to clean up event listeners; merged after bot review non-blocking nitpick with no performance evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 8 changed lines, this is a tiny edit by absolute volume, consistent with a minimal-scope performance fix. It naturally supports a fast, low-risk merge.

review_details.concern_detail: Copilot bot review noted the change uses unsubscribeNotches instead of the existing subscriptions array, suggesting a possible inconsistency in listener management.
review_details.performance_claim: Prevent growing memory usage by removing notch listeners on redraw.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: A simple listener cleanup within a single plugin file required no benchmark or complex justification; merge was immediate after bot review nitpick.

detection_detail.code_reading: Copilot bot reviewed the diff and noted a potential inconsistency in listener tracking.
detection_detail.ci_auto: Cloudflare Pages deployment succeeded on the branch, confirming no build breakage.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark, profiler data, or numeric before/after memory measurements provided; only a narrative claim of preventing memory growth.

core_change_summary.description: In src/plugins/timeline.ts, introduced an unsubscribeNotches array to call unsubscribe callbacks for notch scroll handlers before rebuilding the timeline and on destroy, preventing listener accumulation that caused memory growth on repeated zoom.
change_trajectory: Single commit (f6ec94a) introduced unsubscribeNotches and cleanup logic.

review_signals.summary: Copilot bot posted a pull request overview summarizing the memory leak fix and noted the listener tracking change.
The bot nitpicked that using this.unsubscribeNotches instead of this.subscriptions may create inconsistency in how event listeners are managed.
Cloudflare Pages reported a successful deploy of the branch preview.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened with a single commit fixing the listener memory leak.
Copilot bot reviewed immediately, leaving an inline nitpick and an overview.
Cloudflare Pages deployment succeeded within seconds.
Maintainer merged after ~7 minutes, ignoring the non-blocking nitpick.
